text:
Wrap a present the efficient way! You will need a small box and some paper to wrap it with. Use a box of cereal, or a tissue box if you can find one!

Use a ruler to measure the areas of all of the sides of the box that you are wrapping. Then, work out the total area of paper that you will need to wrap it!

Now cut out this area of the paper in a single rectangle. Can you use it to wrap all of the box? What shape net does it need to cover the whole box using the least paper?
